rows.claim: The validator will fail until MRR is in.
rows.evidence: The validator script printed in T0B3 checks that inputs/plans.json exists (which fails because the file is missing) and that mrr_oct1 is a number in range. A missing key gives v=None, which fails the numeric check, and the exit code is 1 if any check fails. So the validator would fail until MRR is added. It would also keep failing on the missing plans.json input, which the agent did not mention. That does not contradict the claim as stated.
